STANZA I
Thy message, by the preacher, seal
Thy message, by the preacher, seal,
And let thy pow’r be known;
That every sinner here, may feel
The word is not his own.
Where Newton found it
Newton printed the hymn under 2 Corinthians 5:20. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God. 2 CORINTHIANS 5:20 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 2 CORINTHIANS 5
In Jesus, God is reconciled, The worst may be forgiv’n; Come, and he’ll own you as a child, And make you heirs of heav’n. STANZA IV
